additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390749-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/14] Outlet1 out of order CRM:00643001085
additional_info.body:
Hi Bilel,
We have reanalyzed the logs over the past few days, and we have observed that when a charging session occurs on one outlet, the other outlet was not going into an "out of order" state. Specifically, we have seen the
PLC Error Flag 'Outlet_DC1_codes'
being set to
true
a few times per day, indicating a
DC1 Outlet primary converter group error
. Additionally, we have noticed an
SECC CoAP polling issue
, although neither of these errors occur continuously—they disappear after a short time.
If the
DC1 outlet primary converter group error
becomes frequent over the coming months, we may need to replace the contactors. The
SECC CoAP polling issue
is already being addressed by the concern team, and a resolution is expected in an upcoming firmware update.
Note:
Both issues are not frequent at the moment, so there is no immediate need to replace the contactors or apply fixes for the SECC CoAP polling issue.
If you’re satisfied with the explanation, can we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
